title: Seoul Jongno 3-ga: 12 spots for food, drinks and live music
desc: Food, bars and live music around Jongno 3-ga and Ikseon-dong in central Seoul, grouped by sub-area: Tapgol & Songhae, Ikseon-dong and the Nagwon Arcade area.

items.title: Tapgol Park (탑골공원)
items.memo: Former temple grounds with a stone pagoda; a handy landmark to start exploring the area.

items.title: Chicken Baengi (치킨뱅이)
items.memo: 1990s fried chicken chain; try the Sejong Set (plain, yangnyeom and garlic).

items.title: Big Bar
items.memo: Third-floor whiskey bar in the Songhae section.

items.title: Jongno 3-ga Pocha Street (포장마차 거리)
items.memo: Street-food tents by Exits 4-5; try chicken gizzards or boneless spicy feet.

items.title: Salt Pond (Soha Salt Pond)
items.memo: Salt bread bakery with sweet and savory versions, incl. seaweed & fish roe.

items.title: Sikmul (식물)
items.memo: Hanok cafe with hidden rooms; coffee and bread by day, cocktails too.

items.title: Craft Roo
items.memo: Craft beer spot known for its Thai sausage pizza; service can be slow.

items.title: Jang & Paste (장앤페이스트)
items.memo: Italian-Korean: gochujang pastas, sujebi in truffle cream. Book on CatchTable.

items.title: Nagwon Arcade (낙원상가)
items.memo: Instrument market upstairs, traditional market in the basement.

items.title: Cheon Nyeon Jazz Club (천년동안도)
items.memo: Live jazz club just outside Nagwon Arcade.

items.title: EDLS (이들스)
items.memo: 1940s-style club in Nagwon Arcade; jazz & rock, house beer, 10-15k won cover.

items.title: Hadong Jip (하동집)
items.memo: Gukbap (rice soup) spot on Nostalgia Alley, south of Nagwon Arcade.
